title: TKVM Wither
description: Overhauls wither behavior to be more engaging to fight!
body:
# Please report issues in the discord: https://discord.gg/tYMj9rTnCx

### NOTE 

### THE WITHER CURRENTLY IS INCREDIBLY DESTRUCTIVE !
You can disable block breaking in the config.

### Preview video:
<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/27vA0mbRI1Y" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

### Overview

This mod is heavily intended to be used with Epic Fight. While I believe it's beatable in vanilla, it was not designed to be for vanilla. 

It has been tested with epic fight with dodge and parry skills, but I have no reason to believe this wouldnt play well with bettercombat and combatroll. 

Currently, the wither has been tested with Netherite Prot 4 armor, and is intended for this realm of gear. Prot 4 Netherite armor still ensures an extremely difficult fight. 

### So to reiterate: Recommended mods are the following (but not all of them at the same time)
- Epic Fight
- Combat Roll
- Parcool 
- Better Combat

### The Wither

The mod aims to revamp the wither completely in order to make it more engaging, and melee-oriented. 

Added attacks:
- Uppercut - A quick uppercut attack that flings the player into the sky.

- Tackle - A quick tackle that can be blocked with a shield/parry to stun the wither. 

- Sweep - A quick horizontal sweep.

- Charge - A long windup with particles to telegraph the power. Instantly kills players but has a massive tell.

- Slam - The wither ascends and upon reaching the apex falls down and slams the player.

- Hover and Attack - The default flying and shooting pattern, reminiscient of the vanilla wither 

- Strafe - A quick strafe along with a ton of projectiles shot in a row.

- Sky Turret - The wither ascends high in the sky and shoots fast moving projectiles

- Shotgun (Phase 2 exclusive) - A deadly dense blast barrage that is capable of killing the player in 1 shot.
  

These attacks all have phase 2 variants as well. So they become more intense as the fight progresses!

### How to defeat the wither : 

Some attacks give ample opportunity to approach and hit the player. 

After slam - the wither will enter a dizzy state where it can be attacked.

After blocking tackle - the wither gets stunned and you can attack.

All variables for attacks can be tweaked in the config. 

### Config: 
In config-> tkvm_wither-common.toml 

If the wither needs to be nerfed / buffed : 

Use the EZ global modifier for damage output.

	#Global multiplier for all Wither damage output
	#Range: 0.0 ~ 100.0
	globalDamageMultiplier = 1.0

For block breaking : 


	#Master toggle for Wither Skulls. If false, projectiles NEVER break blocks.
	skullsBreakBlocks = true
	chargeBreaksBlocks = true
	crescentSweepBreaksBlocks = true
	deathSequenceBreaksBlocks = true
	hoverBreaksBlocks = true
	shotgunBreaksBlocks = true
	skyTurretBreaksBlocks = true
	slamBreaksBlocks = true
	strafeBreaksBlocks = true
	tackleBreaksBlocks = true
	phaseTwoTransitionBreaksBlocks = true
	uppercutBreaksBlocks = true


# Incompatibilities:

### Immensely incompatible with wither reincarnated. 
I mean, it'll run, it won't crash, but it just completely breaks. Don't try to use it with this mod. 

It's probably just not compatible with any mod that injects behavior into the vanilla wither.
